text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm heading toward the
school gates
after school...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...One more minute until the scheduled
time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If I wait around for Falcon any longer, I
might not
make it to Oi Racecourse on
time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If everything is to proceed without
delay,
punctuality is essential. No matter
the
circumstances, schedules must be
respected...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: However...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hmm! ♪ I can't wait for
tonight's
performance! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Falcon. Perfect timing. I've got a
question to
ask you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What? A question for meee? All right!
My
measurements are— ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That is unnecessary. Are you well
acquainted with
Oi Racecourse?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to watch the eleventh race
today. I plan
to leave the academy at
6:00 p.m. What is the
shortest route
from the stat—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Did you say six?! That's a horrible idea!
It's not
Tokyo Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of transfers, plus it's rush
hour. Even
the smallest thing will make
you late!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess you haven't been to Oi
much.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Well don't you worry, 'cause Falco will be your guide! ☆ I'll teach you to appreciate and enjoy a race there!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Really? But don't you have your own
plans
tonight?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It's fiiiiine! ♪ Let me do something nice
for you
every once in a while! ☆ I know
the best seat in
the house! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...She should be here soon. I'll wait for
one more
minute.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Flaaash! Sorry! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Phew! I almost blew it, but I got here just
in time,
right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: No. You're two seconds late.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Which means we need to run to Oi. That
way we
can get good seats to watch the
race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What?! R-run there?! But it was only two
seconds!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш and Смарт Фалкон take off
running
with smiles on their faces.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
